7. A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0.
B. 𝑣0 cos 𝜃.
C. 𝑣0 sin 𝜃.
D. 0.
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
Q7. A tennis ball is launched with initial speed v_0 at an angle θ above the horizontal (ignore air resistance). What is the ball’s speed at the top of its trajectory?
A. v_0 sin θ
This is incorrect because v_0 sin θ is the initial vertical component, which becomes zero at the top.
B. v_0 cos θ
This is correct because the vertical velocity is zero at maximum height while the horizontal component remains v_0 cos θ.
C. v_0
This is incorrect because the vertical component decreases to zero, so the speed is less than v_0 unless θ = 0.
D. 0
This is incorrect because only the vertical component is zero at the top; the horizontal component generally remains nonzero.
